callers.note: Reads every collection; the positive control for permission cases.

articles.title: Travel and Expense Reimbursement
articles.text:
All business travel must be booked through the corporate travel desk.

# Booking

Flights under six hours are booked in economy class. Flights of six hours or longer may be booked in business class with written director approval. Hotels are capped at 900 AED per night in the GCC and 250 USD per night elsewhere.

# Per Diem

Employees receive a daily allowance of 400 AED for trips inside the UAE and 150 USD per day abroad. The allowance covers meals and local transport, and it is not paid for days on which the client provides meals.

# Claims

Submit expense claims with original receipts within 30 days of returning. Claims submitted later than 30 days require approval from the Chief Financial Officer. Reimbursement is paid with the next monthly salary.

articles.title: Information Security Standards
articles.text:
These standards apply to every employee, contractor and company device.

# Passwords

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must be changed every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, VPN and every finance system. Never share a password, including with the service desk.

# Lost or Stolen Devices

Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone to the IT service desk within one hour, even outside working hours. The device will be remotely wiped. File a police report if the device was stolen and send the reference number to the service desk.

# Removable Media

USB storage devices are blocked on company laptops by default. An exception can be requested from the security team for a fixed period and a named business purpose.

articles.title: Remote Work Policy
articles.text:
# Eligibility

Employees who have completed their probation period may work from home up to two days per week, with their line manager's agreement. Roles that require on-site presence, such as reception and warehouse staff, are not eligible.

# Equipment and Allowance

The company provides a laptop and headset. Eligible employees receive a home internet allowance of 100 AED per month, paid with salary.

# Core Hours

Whether at home or in the office, employees must be reachable during core hours from 10:00 to 15:00 Gulf Standard Time, Monday to Friday.

articles.title: Office Access and Visitors
articles.text:
# Access Badges

Every employee must wear a visible access badge inside the office. A forgotten badge can be replaced with a one-day temporary badge from reception.

# Visitors

Visitors must be registered in the visitor system at least 24 hours before arrival and must be escorted by their host at all times. Visitors may not enter the server room.

# After-Hours Access

The office is open from 07:00 to 20:00. Access outside these hours requires a request to facilities approved by a department head.

articles.title: Leave Entitlements
articles.text:
# Annual Leave

Employees are entitled to 30 calendar days of paid annual leave per year after completing one year of service. Up to 10 unused days may be carried over to the following year, and any remaining balance expires on 31 March.

# Sick Leave

A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than two consecutive days. Sick leave taken on the day before or after a public holiday always requires a certificate.

# Hajj Leave

Muslim employees may take unpaid leave of up to 30 days once during their employment to perform Hajj. Requests must be submitted at least two months in advance.

articles.title: Performance Review Cycle
articles.text:
# Timeline

Mid-year check-ins take place in July. Annual performance reviews are completed in January, and rating decisions are communicated by the end of February.

# Rating Scale

Performance is rated on a five-point scale from Unsatisfactory to Outstanding. Employees rated Outstanding are considered first for promotion.

# Appeals

An employee who disagrees with a rating may appeal in writing to their HR business partner within 14 days of receiving it. The appeal is decided by a panel that does not include the original reviewer.

articles.title: Procurement Approvals
articles.text:
# Approval Thresholds

Purchases up to 10,000 AED can be approved by the line manager. Purchases between 10,000 and 50,000 AED need the department head. Purchases above 50,000 AED need three competing quotations and approval from the Chief Financial Officer.

# Vendor Onboarding

A new vendor must provide a valid trade license, a VAT registration certificate and bank details on company letterhead before the first purchase order is issued.

# Payment Terms

Standard payment terms are 45 days from the date a valid tax invoice is received.

articles.title: VAT and Invoicing
articles.text:
# Tax Invoices

Every tax invoice we issue must show our Tax Registration Number, the customer's name and address, the VAT rate of 5 percent and the VAT amount in AED.

# Credit Notes

A credit note must reference the original invoice number and be issued within 14 days of agreeing a refund with the customer.

# Foreign Currency

Invoices may be issued in USD, but the VAT amount must also be shown in AED using the Central Bank exchange rate on the invoice date.

articles.title: سياسة التعامل مع شكاوى العملاء
articles.text:
تنطبق هذه السياسة على جميع قنوات خدمة العملاء.

# استلام الشكوى

تُسجَّل كل شكوى في نظام إدارة علاقات العملاء فور استلامها، سواء وصلت عبر الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني أو الموقع الإلكتروني، ويحصل العميل على رقم مرجعي.

# مدة الرد

يجب الإقرار باستلام الشكوى خلال يومي عمل، وحلّها خلال عشرة أيام عمل من تاريخ استلامها.

# التصعيد

إذا لم تُحلّ الشكوى خلال المدة المحددة، تُصعَّد تلقائيًا إلى مدير خدمة العملاء، ويُبلَّغ العميل بالتصعيد كتابيًا.

articles.title: الاحتفاظ بالسجلات
articles.text:
# مدد الاحتفاظ

يُحتفظ بالعقود لمدة عشر سنوات بعد انتهائها، وبالفواتير والسجلات المالية لمدة خمس سنوات، وبملفات الموظفين لمدة سنتين بعد انتهاء الخدمة.

# الإتلاف

لا يجوز إتلاف أي سجل قبل انتهاء مدة الاحتفاظ به، ويتطلب الإتلاف موافقة كتابية من إدارة الامتثال.

# النسخ الإلكترونية

تخضع النسخ الإلكترونية للمدد نفسها، وتُحذف من أنظمة النسخ الاحتياطي خلال تسعين يومًا من تاريخ الإتلاف المعتمد.

articles.title: ساعات العمل خلال شهر رمضان
articles.text:
# ساعات الدوام

تُخفَّض ساعات العمل خلال شهر رمضان إلى ست ساعات يوميًا، من التاسعة صباحًا حتى الثالثة عصرًا، لجميع الموظفين.

# العمل عن بعد في رمضان

يجوز للموظفين المؤهلين للعمل عن بعد زيادة أيام العمل من المنزل إلى ثلاثة أيام أسبوعيًا خلال شهر رمضان، بعد موافقة المدير المباشر.

# الاجتماعات

يُفضَّل ألا تُعقد الاجتماعات بعد الساعة الثانية ظهرًا خلال شهر رمضان.

articles.title: New Joiner Onboarding دليل الموظف الجديد
articles.text:
Welcome to the company. مرحبًا بك في الشركة.

# First Day - اليوم الأول

Bring your original passport and Emirates ID (الهوية الإماراتية) to reception at 08:30. Collect your laptop from the IT service desk after your ID photo is taken.

# Payroll Setup - إعداد الراتب

Salaries are paid through the Wage Protection System (WPS). أرسل رقم الآيبان IBAN الخاص بحسابك البنكي إلى قسم الرواتب خلال أسبوعك الأول، وإلا سيتأخر راتبك الأول.

# التدريب الإلزامي - Mandatory Training

يجب على كل موظف جديد إكمال دورتي Code of Conduct و Information Security خلال أسبوعين من تاريخ الانضمام، عبر منصة التعلّم الإلكتروني.
